visual_enhancers: 1px sharp grid borders utilizing border-collapse to prevent double lines
Neon accent lighting for status indicators, strictly localized—NO gradients
Terminal-like monospaced data alignment across all tables and grids
Micro-progress bars overlaying numeric metrics for immediate visual scanning (confidence/safety pills)

layouts.base: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex bg-[#050505] text-[#F2F2F2] selection:bg-[#007AFF]/30
layouts.navigation: w-16 h-full flex flex-col items-center border-r border-[#262626] shrink-0 bg-[#0D0D0D]
layouts.header: h-12 w-full flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#262626] px-4 shrink-0 bg-[#0D0D0D]
layouts.panels: w-[40vw] max-w-2xl h-full border-l border-[#262626] bg-[#1A1A1A] shadow-2xl z-50 absolute right-0

motion.transitions: Instant (0ms) or max 150ms linear for data elements. 250ms ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for large panels. No bounce.
motion.hover: Strictly functional background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-white/5). NO scale or translate animations on data rows.

accessibility.contrast: Adhere strictly to APCA standard minimums. High contrast neon over pure black preferred.
accessibility.keyboard: All actions must have visible keyboard access keys (e.g., A for Approve, ESC for close, Arrows for navigation).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn/UI for pure interaction primitives, but strip away default aesthetics (soft shadows, large rounded corners).
Enforce rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm (2px) on all elements.
Do not use transparent backgrounds over content—use solid #0D0D0D or #1A1A1A for dropdowns and overlays to ensure perfect legibility.
Completely avoid gradients, purple/violet hues, and consumer SaaS patterns.
Data density is critical: Base text size is 13px, table rows are 32px height (dense mode).
Never display standard 'No data found' empty states. Always render terminal-style 'Gate Drops' showing why the data was pruned.
Apply 'data-testid' to every interactive and data-bearing element.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Focus on extreme institutional utility. Eliminate 'AI slop' by avoiding drop shadows, rounded bubbles, and decorative illustrations. Rely on 1px crisp borders, pure flat surfaces, high-contrast neon text against deep obsidian, and monospace alignment. All interfaces must feel like a high-velocity terminal. Do NOT center align dashboards—left-align data. Ensure all interactive components have 0ms-latency hover states and are keyboard-operable. Add general UI UX design guidelines: provide clear system feedback on every action, keep navigation persistent, and support progressive disclosure (L1 to L3) within the right-side Entity Drawer.
